newsitem.title: USA: Medicis in pact with Abbott Labs.
newsitem.headline: Medicis in pact with Abbott Labs.

text.p: Medicis Pharmaceutical Corp said Monday it entered into a collaborative pact with Abbott Laboratories Inc for the development of a dermatological product.
Under the terms of this agreement, Abbott will be responsible for pharmaceutical development and manufacturing, and Medicis will have responsibility for marketing and distribution, Medicis said.
Specific product information was not immediately available.
Medicis, which offers prescription, non-prescription, and physician-dispensed treatments exclusively for skin conditions, gained 3-1/2 to 53.
